dct_description_sm: The primary objective of this study was to investigate the effects of transport duration on diarrhea, respiratory disease, and growth in young surplus dairy calves following 6, 12, and 16 h of continuous road transport from source dairy farms to a single commercial veal facility. The secondary objective was to explore how variables such as breed, sex, transfer of passive immunity status, weight before transport, and age at transport influence calf health following transport. This dataset contains supplementary material for the following publication: H. M. Goetz, K. C. Creutzinger, D. F. Kelton, J. H. C. Costa, C. B. Winder, and D. L. Renaud. 2023. A randomized controlled trial investigating the effect of transport duration and age at transport on surplus dairy calves: Part I. Impact on health and growth. Journal of Dairy Science. 106(4): 2784-2799. https://doi.org/10.3168/jds.2022-22366.
dct_title_s: Supplementary material for: A randomized controlled trial investigating the effect of transport duration and age at transport on surplus dairy calves: Part I. Impact on health and growth
